proposal_record.raw:
{
  "diagnosis": "Recurring failures come from three generalizable causes: (1) selecting an option for the stated indication while overlooking a documented patient-specific safety constraint that makes that option inappropriate (e.g., immunosuppression, organ impairment, allergy history, interacting current medicine); (2) treating absence of a documented interaction as positive evidence of safety while failing to actively retrieve the exact current-medication statements and the exact contraindication-relevant history statements from the dialogue; (3) selecting a non-first-line, non-indicated, or less appropriate drug when the best-supported option is the one that is both indicated and has no patient-specific blocking fact. The prior skills did not require explicit comparison of each candidate against every retrieved patient constraint, so the agent defaulted to the most familiar disease-drug pair.",
  "skills": [
    {
      "id": "constraint_first_selection",
      "text": "Before finalizing, retrieve all patient-specific constraints (current medicines, organ disease/transplant, immunosuppression, allergy severity, prior reactions, missing doses) as exact dialogue excerpts. For each candidate, ask: is it indicated for the working diagnosis, and does any retrieved constraint block, reduce, or complicate its use? Prefer the indicated option with no blocking constraint over an option that is also indicated but is contradicted or made less safe by a retrieved fact. Never infer safety from the mere absence of a stated interaction."
    },
    {
      "id": "active_medication_interaction_check",
      "text": "When any current medicine is stated, treat it as an active safety filter, not background. Identify each current medicine by name and class, then screen candidates for added CNS depression, QT, bleeding, renal/hepatic, electrolyte, or immunosuppressive burden. Do not select an option whose class is additive or interacting with a stated medicine when an equally indicated non-interacting option exists. Quote the exact medication sentence from the dialogue as evidence."
    },
    {
      "id": "immunosuppression_and_organ_disease_caution",
      "text": "If transplant, immunosuppressive therapy, kidney disease, liver disease, or similar organ-compromise history is stated, flag any candidate that increases infection risk, requires renal/hepatic dose caution, or depends on organ function. This flag should lower that candidate unless it is the only indicated option, and the final choice should favor the indicated option with the safer profile for the stated organ/immune status."
    },
    {
      "id": "first_line_indication_priority",
      "text": "Choose the candidate that is a recognized first-line or clearly indicated therapy for the working diagnosis and is compatible with retrieved constraints. Do not choose a drug that is only adjunctive, non-first-line monotherapy, or used for an unrelated indication when a directly indicated option exists. If two options are both indicated, the tie-breaker is patient-specific safety, not familiarity."
    },
    {
      "id": "exact_excerpt_evidence_requirement",
      "text": "For every constraint relied on, cite the exact dialogue excerpt (verbatim phrase/sentence) rather than paraphrasing. If a fact is not present verbatim, do not treat it as present. If the dialogue only implies a condition without explicitly naming it, retrieve the symptom/history excerpt that supports the implication and state the inference explicitly."
    }
  ],
  "focus_terms": [
    "I'm taking",
    "I am currently taking",
    "currently taking",
    "history of",
    "allergic reaction",
    "severe allergic reaction",
    "kidney transplant",
    "kidney disease",
    "immunosuppressive",
    "colostomy",
    "blood clotting disorder",
    "forgot to take",
    "missed doses",
    "medical history",
    "underlying medical conditions",
    "other medications",
    "any other medications",
    "antibiotic-resistant",
    "chickenpox as a child",
    "shingles",
    "kidney failure",
    "transplant team"
  ],
  "modules": {
    "patient_evidence": "Extract verbatim: working diagnosis; every stated symptom cluster; every current medicine with name; every past medical/surgical history; allergy history and severity; organ transplant/disease; immunosuppression; adherence/missed doses. For each extracted fact, record the exact dialogue excerpt. If a diagnosis is implied but not named, record the supporting excerpt and mark it as an inference.",
    "safety_check": "Build a per-candidate constraint table. Rows: each candidate drug; columns: indication match, interaction with each current medicine, organ-function/immunosuppression caution, allergy/contraindication history. Use only facts present as exact excerpts. A candidate is blocked if a retrieved excerpt directly contradicts it; it is disfavored if it adds risk in a class already implicated by a current medicine or organ/immune status. Do not downgrade a candidate merely because an interaction is not mentioned.",
    "option_selection": "Rank candidates in this order: (1) indicated for the working diagnosis; (2) no blocking patient-specific constraint from retrieved excerpts; (3) lowest added interaction/organ/immune burden relative to current medicines and history; (4) first-line over adjunctive/non-first-line. Pick the highest-ranked candidate. If the top two are both indicated and unblocked, choose the one with the safer patient-specific profile, not the more familiar drug."
  }
}
